description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It creates multiple test cases via the XML-RPC API provided by TestLink, establishing a client connection, setting parameters, and looping to create specified test cases.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: Client class used for XML-RPC communication with the TestLink API.

methods.description: Function to send a test creation request to the XML-RPC server with provided method and arguments.
